answer: Each identity claims one timber stand, locking a 70-credit bond on a public mirror ledger that decays 10 credits an epoch. Each epoch it files a zephyr gust reading there; auditors check it on the wind table, and a copied or mismatched reading burns the bond. Each fake pays 45 an epoch, so 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 for a 40,000 pool; rented readings fail when two stands report one gust. An honest agent tends one stand and keeps its bond.
